1→# Authentik Setup Guide
     2→
     3→This document covers the complete setup of Authentik as the centralized identity provider for the homelab, replacing Authelia. Authentik provides both OIDC provider capabilities (for apps with native OAuth support) and forward auth (for apps without).
     4→
     5→## Why Authentik?
     6→
     7→| Feature | Authelia | TinyAuth | Authentik |
     8→| --------- | ---------- | ---------- | ----------- |
     9→| Third-party OIDC (Google/GitHub) | No (is IdP only) | Yes (client only) | Yes (both IdP and client) |
    10→| OIDC Provider for apps | Yes | No | Yes |
    11→| Forward Auth | Yes | Yes | Yes |
    12→| User/Group Management UI | Limited | No | Full UI |
    13→| Role-based Access Control | Basic | Per-app labels | Full RBAC with policies |
    14→| Jellyfin SSO Plugin compatible | Yes | No | Yes |
    15→| Mobile app compatibility | N/A | N/A | Yes (proper OIDC) |
    16→| Memory footprint | ~512MB | ~50MB | ~1GB |
    17→| Complexity | Medium | Simple | More complex |
    18→
    19→## Architecture Overview
    20→
    21→```text
    22→                         ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
    23→                         │              AUTHENTIK                   │
    24→                         │                                          │
    25→                         │  ┌────────────┐     ┌────────────┐      │
    26→                         │  │  Google    │     │  GitHub    │      │
    27→                         │  │  Source    │     │  Source    │      │
    28→                         │  └─────┬──────┘     └─────┬──────┘      │
    29→                         │        └───────┬──────────┘             │
    30→                         │                ▼                         │
    31→                         │     ┌────────────────────┐              │
    32→                         │     │   Users & Groups   │              │
    33→                         │     │  - admins          │              │
    34→                         │     │  - users           │              │
    35→                         │     │  - jellyfin-admins │              │
    36→                         │     └─────────┬──────────┘              │
    37→                         │               │                          │
    38→                         │    ┌──────────┴──────────┐              │
    39→                         │    ▼                     ▼               │
    40→                         │ ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐      │
    41→                         │ │OIDC Providers│  │Proxy Outpost │      │
    42→                         │ │ (7 apps)     │  │(Forward Auth)│      │
    43→                         │ └──────┬───────┘  └───────┬──────┘      │
    44→                         └────────┼──────────────────┼─────────────┘
    45→                                  │                  │
    46→        ┌─────────────────────────┼──────────────────┼─────────────────────────┐
    47→        │                         │                  │                         │
    48→        ▼                         ▼                  ▼                         ▼
    49→  ┌───────────┐            ┌───────────┐      ┌───────────┐            ┌───────────┐
    50→  │ Jellyfin  │            │  Immich   │      │  Grafana  │            │ Homepage  │
    51→  │ (OIDC)    │            │  (OIDC)   │      │  (OIDC)   │            │ (Proxy)   │
    52→  └───────────┘            └───────────┘      └───────────┘            └───────────┘
    53→                                                                       + 17 more
    54→```
    55→
    56→## Deployment Architecture
    57→
    58→Authentik will be deployed alongside Traefik in the same LXC (container 200) for the following reasons:
    59→
    60→1. **Frequent Communication**: Traefik's forward auth middleware makes requests to Authentik on every protected request
    61→2. **Reduced Latency**: Same-host communication avoids network hops
    62→3. **Simplified Networking**: No cross-container firewall rules needed
    63→4. **Resource Efficiency**: Traefik is lightweight, leaving room for Authentik
    64→
    65→### Resource Allocation (LXC 200)
    66→
    67→| Component | CPU | Memory | Notes |
    68→| ----------- | ----- | -------- | ------- |
    69→| Traefik | 0.5 cores | 256MB | Lightweight reverse proxy |
    70→| Authentik Server | 1 core | 512MB | Main application |
    71→| Authentik Worker | 0.5 cores | 256MB | Background tasks |

   436→
   437→```hcl

   439→  vault = "Homelab"
   440→  title = "Authentik"
   441→}
   442→

   444→  content  = data.onepassword_item.authentik.section[0].field[0].value
   445→  filename = "${path.module}/deploy/authentik/secrets/pg_password"
   446→}
   447→
   448→resource "local_file" "secret_key" {
   449→  content  = data.onepassword_item.authentik.section[0].field[1].value

   454→## 9. Migration from Authelia
   455→
   456→### Pre-Migration Checklist
   457→
   458→- [ ] Authentik deployed and accessible
   459→- [ ] Google OAuth source configured
   460→- [ ] GitHub OAuth source configured (optional)
   461→- [ ] Groups created
   462→- [ ] Forward auth middleware configured
   463→- [ ] Test user can log in via Google

   467→1. Deploy Authentik alongside Authelia (both running)
   468→2. Create `authentik` middleware in Traefik (separate from `authelia`)
   469→3. Migrate one service at a time by changing middleware
   470→4. Verify each service works before proceeding
   471→5. After all services migrated, remove Authelia
   472→
   473→### Rollback Plan
   474→
   475→Keep Authelia running until all services are verified. To rollback:
   476→
   477→1. Change middleware from `authentik` back to `authelia`
   478→2. Reload Traefik configuration

   482→### Forward Auth Returns 401
   483→
   484→1. Check Authentik logs: `docker logs authentik-server`
   485→2. Verify the outpost is running and has the application assigned
   486→3. Check the forward auth URL in Traefik middleware
   487→
   488→### OAuth Redirect Loop
   489→
   490→1. Ensure redirect URIs match exactly (including trailing slashes)
   491→2. Check that cookies are being set (same domain)
   492→3. Verify HTTPS is working correctly
   493→
   494→### User Not in Group After OAuth Login
   495→
   496→1. Check user matching mode on the OAuth source
   497→2. Verify the user was linked (not created as new)
   498→3. Manually add user to groups if needed

# Authentik Setup Guide

This document covers the complete setup of Authentik as the centralized identity provider for the homelab, replacing Authelia. Authentik provides both OIDC provider capabilities (for apps with native OAuth support) and forward auth (for apps without).

## Why Authentik?

| Feature | Authelia | TinyAuth | Authentik |
| --------- | ---------- | ---------- | ----------- |
| Third-party OIDC (Google/GitHub) | No (is IdP only) | Yes (client only) | Yes (both IdP and client) |
| OIDC Provider for apps | Yes | No | Yes |
| Forward Auth | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| User/Group Management UI | Limited | No | Full UI |
| Role-based Access Control | Basic | Per-app labels | Full RBAC with policies |
| Jellyfin SSO Plugin compatible | Yes | No | Yes |
| Mobile app compatibility | N/A | N/A | Yes (proper OIDC) |
| Memory footprint | ~512MB | ~50MB | ~1GB |
| Complexity | Medium | Simple | More complex |

## Architecture Overview

```text
                         ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
                         │              AUTHENTIK                   │
                         │                                          │
                         │  ┌────────────┐     ┌────────────┐      │
                         │  │  Google    │     │  GitHub    │      │
                         │  │  Source    │     │  Source    │      │
                         │  └─────┬──────┘     └─────┬──────┘      │
                         │        └───────┬──────────┘             │
                         │                ▼                         │
                         │     ┌────────────────────┐              │
                         │     │   Users & Groups   │              │
                         │     │  - admins          │              │
                         │     │  - users           │              │
                         │     │  - jellyfin-admins │              │
                         │     └─────────┬──────────┘              │
                         │               │                          │
                         │    ┌──────────┴──────────┐              │
                         │    ▼                     ▼               │
                         │ ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐      │
                         │ │OIDC Providers│  │Proxy Outpost │      │
                         │ │ (7 apps)     │  │(Forward Auth)│      │
                         │ └──────┬───────┘  └───────┬──────┘      │
                         └────────┼──────────────────┼─────────────┘
                                  │                  │
        ┌─────────────────────────┼──────────────────┼─────────────────────────┐
        │                         │                  │                         │
        ▼                         ▼                  ▼                         ▼
  ┌───────────┐            ┌───────────┐      ┌───────────┐            ┌───────────┐
  │ Jellyfin  │            │  Immich   │      │  Grafana  │            │ Homepage  │
  │ (OIDC)    │            │  (OIDC)   │      │  (OIDC)   │            │ (Proxy)   │
  └───────────┘            └───────────┘      └───────────┘            └───────────┘
                                                                       + 17 more
```

## Deployment Architecture

Authentik will be deployed alongside Traefik in the same LXC (container 200) for the following reasons:

1. **Frequent Communication**: Traefik's forward auth middleware makes requests to Authentik on every protected request
2. **Reduced Latency**: Same-host communication avoids network hops
3. **Simplified Networking**: No cross-container firewall rules needed
4. **Resource Efficiency**: Traefik is lightweight, leaving room for Authentik

### Resource Allocation (LXC 200)

| Component | CPU | Memory | Notes |
| ----------- | ----- | -------- | ------- |
| Traefik | 0.5 cores | 256MB | Lightweight reverse proxy |
| Authentik Server | 1 core | 512MB | Main application |
| Authentik Worker | 0.5 cores | 256MB | Background tasks |
| PostgreSQL | 0.5 cores | 256MB | Database |
| Redis | 0.25 cores | 128MB | Cache/sessions |
| **Total** | 2.75 cores | 1.4GB | Recommend 4 cores, 2GB |

## 1. Authentik Container Setup

### Docker Compose Configuration

```yaml
# Authentik - Identity Provider
# https://goauthentik.io/

name: authentik

services:
  postgresql:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: authentik-postgres
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: authentik
      POSTGRES_USER: authentik
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/pg_password
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    secrets:
      - pg_password
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -d authentik -U authentik"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    restart: unless-stopped

  redis:
    image: redis:8-alpine
    container_name: authentik-redis
    command: --save 60 1 --loglevel warning
    volumes:
      - redis-data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    restart: unless-stopped

  server:
    image: ghcr.io/goauthentik/server:2024.12
    container_name: authentik-server
    command: server
    environment:
      AUTHENTIK_REDIS__HOST: redis
      AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__HOST: postgresql
      AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__USER: authentik
      AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__NAME: authentik
      AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__PASSWORD: file:///run/secrets/pg_password
      AUTHENTIK_SECRET_KEY: file:///run/secrets/secret_key
      AUTHENTIK_ERROR_REPORTING__ENABLED: false
      # Email (optional)
      # AUTHENTIK_EMAIL__HOST: smtp.example.com
      # AUTHENTIK_EMAIL__PORT: 587
      # AUTHENTIK_EMAIL__USE_TLS: true
    ports:
      - "9000:9000"   # HTTP
      - "9443:9443"   # HTTPS
    volumes:
      - ./media:/media
      - ./custom-templates:/templates
    secrets:
      - pg_password
      - secret_key
    depends_on:
      postgresql:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped

  worker:
    image: ghcr.io/goauthentik/server:2024.12
    container_name: authentik-worker
    command: worker
    environment:
      AUTHENTIK_REDIS__HOST: redis
      AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__HOST: postgresql
      AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__USER: authentik
      AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__NAME: authentik
      AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__PASSWORD: file:///run/secrets/pg_password
      AUTHENTIK_SECRET_KEY: file:///run/secrets/secret_key
    volumes:
      - ./media:/media
      - ./certs:/certs
      - ./custom-templates:/templates
    secrets:
      - pg_password
      - secret_key
    depends_on:
      postgresql:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped

secrets:
  pg_password:
    file: ./secrets/pg_password
  secret_key:
    file: ./secrets/secret_key

volumes:
  postgres-data:
  redis-data:
```

### Secrets Generation

```bash
# Generate secrets
mkdir -p secrets
openssl rand -base64 32 > secrets/pg_password
openssl rand -base64 60 > secrets/secret_key
```

### Initial Setup

After starting the containers, create the admin user:

```bash
docker exec -it authentik-server ak create_admin_user
```

Or access the initial setup at: `https://auth.homelab.rambtech.dev/if/flow/initial-setup/`

## 2. Google OAuth Source Setup

### Step 1: Create Google Cloud OAuth App

1. Go to [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/)
2. Create or select a project
3. Navigate to **APIs & Services > Credentials**
4. Click **Create Credentials > OAuth client ID**
5. Configure:
   - **Application type**: Web application
   - **Name**: Authentik Homelab

2. Click **Create** and select **Proxy Provider**

   - **Name**: Traefik Forward Auth
   - **Authorization flow**: default-provider-authorization-implicit-consent
   - **Mode**: Forward auth (single application)
   - **External host**: `https://auth.homelab.rambtech.dev`

### Authentik Application Setup

1. Navigate to **Applications > Applications**
2. Click **Create**
3. Configure:
   - **Name**: Traefik Forward Auth
   - **Slug**: traefik-forward-auth
   - **Provider**: Traefik Forward Auth (created above)

### Outpost Configuration

1. Navigate to **Applications > Outposts**
2. Edit the **authentik Embedded Outpost**
3. Add your application to the outpost

### Traefik Middleware Configuration

Add to your Traefik dynamic configuration:

```yaml
# /config/dynamic/common.yml
http:
  middlewares:
    authentik:
      forwardAuth:
        address: "http://localhost:9000/outpost.goauthentik.io/auth/traefik"
        trustForwardHeader: true
        authResponseHeaders:
          - X-authentik-username
          - X-authentik-groups
          - X-authentik-email
          - X-authentik-name
          - X-authentik-uid
          - X-authentik-jwt
          - X-authentik-meta-jwks
          - X-authentik-meta-outpost
          - X-authentik-meta-provider
          - X-authentik-meta-app
          - X-authentik-meta-version
```

**Note**: Since Authentik runs in the same LXC as Traefik, use `localhost:9000` instead of a container IP.

### Protecting a Service with Forward Auth

```yaml
http:
  routers:
    homepage:
      rule: "Host(`homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev`)"
      entryPoints:
        - websecure
      service: homepage
      tls:
        certResolver: letsencrypt
      middlewares:
        - security-headers
        - authentik  # Add this
```

# Expression policy: restrict-oauth-users

## 9. Migration from Authelia

### Pre-Migration Checklist

- [ ] Authentik deployed and accessible
- [ ] Google OAuth source configured
- [ ] GitHub OAuth source configured (optional)
- [ ] Groups created
- [ ] Forward auth middleware configured
- [ ] Test user can log in via Google

### Migration Steps

1. Deploy Authentik alongside Authelia (both running)
2. Create `authentik` middleware in Traefik (separate from `authelia`)
3. Migrate one service at a time by changing middleware
4. Verify each service works before proceeding
5. After all services migrated, remove Authelia

### Rollback Plan

Keep Authelia running until all services are verified. To rollback:

1. Change middleware from `authentik` back to `authelia`
2. Reload Traefik configuration

## Troubleshooting

### Forward Auth Returns 401

1. Check Authentik logs: `docker logs authentik-server`
2. Verify the outpost is running and has the application assigned
3. Check the forward auth URL in Traefik middleware

### OAuth Redirect Loop

1. Ensure redirect URIs match exactly (including trailing slashes)
2. Check that cookies are being set (same domain)
3. Verify HTTPS is working correctly

### User Not in Group After OAuth Login

1. Check user matching mode on the OAuth source
2. Verify the user was linked (not created as new)
3. Manually add user to groups if needed

# Authentik Services Integration Guide

This document covers how to integrate each homelab service with Authentik,
categorized by authentication method: Native OIDC or Forward Auth (Proxy).

## Service Categories Summary

| Category | Auth Method | Services |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Native OIDC | Direct OAuth/OIDC | Jellyfin, Immich, Grafana, OpenWebUI, Paperless-ngx, n8n, Jellyseerr |
| Forward Auth | Proxy Outpost | Homepage, Dashy, Prometheus, Alertmanager, Uptime Kuma, AdGuard, qBittorrent, Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Prowlarr, Bazarr, SABnzbd, Traefik Dashboard, Pulse, Arcane, Stirling-PDF, ntfy |
| Native Only | Keep existing auth | Ollama API |

---

## Part 1: Native OIDC Applications

These applications connect directly to Authentik as an OIDC provider. Users get true SSO with proper session management.

---

### Jellyfin (`jellyfin.rambtech.dev`)

**Auth Method**: Native OIDC via SSO Plugin

**Why OIDC**: Preserves Quick Connect for TV/mobile apps while enabling Google login on web.

**Authentik Setup:**

1. **Create Provider** (Applications > Providers > Create > OAuth2/OpenID Provider):
   - Name: `Jellyfin`
   - Authorization flow: `default-provider-authorization-explicit-consent`
   - Client type: `Confidential`
   - Redirect URIs:

    ```text
    https://jellyfin.rambtech.dev/sso/OID/redirect/authentik
    ```

   - Scopes: `openid email profile groups`
   - Under **Advanced protocol settings**, add the `groups` scope

2. **Create Application** (Applications > Applications > Create):
   - Name: `Jellyfin`
   - Slug: `jellyfin`
   - Provider: `Jellyfin`
   - Launch URL: `https://jellyfin.rambtech.dev`

3. **Group Bindings** (optional):
   - Bind `jellyfin-admins` group for admin access

#### Jellyfin Configuration

1. **Install SSO Plugin**:
   - Add repository: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/9p4/jellyfin-plugin-sso/manifest-release/manifest.json`
   - Install "SSO Authentication" from catalog
   - Restart Jellyfin

2. **Configure Plugin** (Dashboard > Plugins > SSO):

  ```yaml
  Provider: OpenID Connect
  OID Provider Name: authentik
  OID Client ID: (from Authentik)
  OID Client Secret: (from Authentik)
  OID Discovery URL: https://auth.homelab.rambtech.dev/application/o/jellyfin/.well-known/openid-configuration
  Enabled: true
  Enable Authorization: true
  Enable All Folders: false
  Roles: ["jellyfin-admins"]  # Group for admin users
  Admin Roles: ["jellyfin-admins"]
  Enable Folder Roles: false
  ```

1. **Add Login Button** (Dashboard > General > Branding > Login disclaimer):

   ```html
   <form action="https://jellyfin.rambtech.dev/sso/OID/start/authentik">
     <button class="raised block emby-button button-submit">
       Sign in with Authentik
     </button>
   </form>
   ```

---

### Immich (`photos.rambtech.dev`)

**Auth Method**: Native OIDC

**Why OIDC**: Mobile app compatibility with custom URI scheme.

#### Configuration

1. **Create Provider**:
   - Name: `Immich`
   - Client type: `Confidential`
   - Redirect URIs:

    ```text
    app.immich:///oauth-callback
    https://photos.rambtech.dev/auth/login
    https://photos.rambtech.dev/user-settings
    ```

   - Scopes: `openid email profile`

2. **Create Application**:
   - Name: `Immich`
   - Slug: `immich`
   - Provider: `Immich`
   - Launch URL: `https://photos.rambtech.dev/auth/login?autoLaunch=1`

#### Immich Configuration

In Immich Admin UI (Administration > Settings > OAuth Authentication):

| Setting | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Enable | Yes |
| Issuer URL | `https://auth.homelab.rambtech.dev/application/o/immich/` |
| Client ID | (from Authentik) |
| Client Secret | (from Authentik) |
| Scope | `openid email profile` |
| Button Text | `Login with Authentik` |
| Auto Register | Yes |
| Auto Launch | Yes (optional) |

---

### Grafana (`grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev`)

**Auth Method**: Native OIDC (Generic OAuth)

**Why OIDC**: Full role mapping from Authentik groups to Grafana roles.

**Authentik Setup:**

1. **Create Provider**:
   - Name: `Grafana`
   - Client type: `Confidential`
   - Redirect URIs:

    ```text
    https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev/login/generic_oauth
    ```

   - Scopes: `openid email profile groups`

2. **Create Application**:
   - Name: `Grafana`
   - Slug: `grafana`
   - Provider: `Grafana`
   - Bind `grafana-admins` group for admin access

#### Grafana Configuration

**grafana.ini** or environment variables:

```ini
[server]
root_url = https://grafana.homelab.rambtech.dev

[auth.generic_oauth]
enabled = true
name = Authentik
icon = signin
allow_sign_up = true
auto_login = false
client_id = grafana-client-id
client_secret = grafana-client-secret
scopes = openid email profile groups
auth_url = https://auth.homelab.rambtech.dev/application/o/authorize/
token_url = https://auth.homelab.rambtech.dev/application/o/token/
api_url = https://auth.homelab.rambtech.dev/application/o/userinfo/
role_attribute_path = contains(groups[*], 'grafana-admins') && 'GrafanaAdmin' || contains(groups[*], 'admins') && 'Admin' || 'Viewer'
allow_assign_grafana_admin = true

[auth]
signout_redirect_url = https://auth.homelab.rambtech.dev/application/o/grafana/end-session/
```

---

### OpenWebUI (`openwebui.homelab.rambtech.dev`)

**Auth Method**: Native OIDC

**Authentik Setup:**

1. **Create Provider**:
   - Name: `OpenWebUI`
   - Client type: `Confidential`
   - Redirect URIs:

     ```text
     https://openwebui.homelab.rambtech.dev/oauth/oidc/callback
     ```

   - Scopes: `openid email profile groups`

2. **Create Application**:
   - Name: `OpenWebUI`
   - Slug: `openwebui`
   - Provider: `OpenWebUI`

#### OpenWebUI Configuration

```yaml
environment:
  OAUTH_CLIENT_ID: "openwebui-client-id"
  OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET: "openwebui-client-secret"
  OAUTH_PROVIDER_NAME: "Authentik"
  OPENID_PROVIDER_URL: "https://auth.homelab.rambtech.dev/application/o/openwebui/.well-known/openid-configuration"
  OPENID_REDIRECT_URI: "https://openwebui.homelab.rambtech.dev/oauth/oidc/callback"
  OAUTH_SCOPES: "openid email profile groups"
  ENABLE_OAUTH_SIGNUP: "true"
  ENABLE_LOGIN_FORM: "false"  # Optional: disable password login
  OAUTH_MERGE_ACCOUNTS_BY_EMAIL: "true"
  ENABLE_OAUTH_GROUP_MANAGEMENT: "true"
  OAUTH_GROUP_CLAIM: "groups"
```

---

### Paperless-ngx (`paperless.homelab.rambtech.dev`)

**Auth Method**: Native OIDC (via django-allauth)

**Authentik Setup:**

1. **Create Provider**:
   - Name: `Paperless`
   - Client type: `Confidential`
   - Redirect URIs:

    ```text
    https://paperless.homelab.rambtech.dev/accounts/oidc/authentik/login/callback/
    ```

   - Scopes: `openid email profile`

2. **Create Application**:
   - Name: `Paperless`
   - Slug: `paperless`
   - Provider: `Paperless`

#### Paperless-ngx Configuration

```yaml
environment:
  PAPERLESS_APPS: "allauth.socialaccount.providers.openid_connect"
  PAPERLESS_SOCIALACCOUNT_PROVIDERS: |
    {
      "openid_connect": {
        "APPS": [{
          "provider_id": "authentik",
          "name": "Authentik",
          "client_id": "paperless-client-id",
          "secret": "paperless-client-secret",
          "settings": {
            "server_url": "https://auth.homelab.rambtech.dev/application/o/paperless/.well-known/openid-configuration"
          }
        }]
      }
    }
  PAPERLESS_SOCIAL_AUTO_SIGNUP: "true"
  PAPERLESS_REDIRECT_LOGIN_TO_SSO: "true"
  PAPERLESS_DISABLE_REGULAR_LOGIN: "false"  # Keep as backup
```

---

### n8n (`n8n.homelab.rambtech.dev`)

**Auth Method**: Native OIDC

**Authentik Setup:**

1. **Create Provider**:
   - Name: `n8n`
   - Client type: `Confidential`
   - Redirect URIs:

    ```text
    https://n8n.homelab.rambtech.dev/rest/sso/oidc/callback
    ```

   - Scopes: `openid email profile`
   - Add custom scope `n8n` with claims

2. **Create Application**:
   - Name: `n8n`
   - Slug: `n8n`
   - Provider: `n8n`

#### n8n Configuration

```yaml
environment:
  N8N_SSO_OIDC_ENABLED: "true"
  N8N_SSO_OIDC_CLIENT_ID: "n8n-client-id"
  N8N_SSO_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET: "n8n-client-secret"
  N8N_SSO_OIDC_ISSUER: "https://auth.homelab.rambtech.dev/application/o/n8n/"
  N8N_SSO_OIDC_CALLBACK_URL: "https://n8n.homelab.rambtech.dev/rest/sso/oidc/callback"
```

---

### Jellyseerr (`requests.rambtech.dev`)

**Auth Method**: Native OIDC (if using latest version with OIDC support)

**Authentik Setup:**

1. **Create Provider**:
   - Name: `Jellyseerr`
   - Client type: `Confidential`
   - Redirect URIs:

     ```text
     https://requests.rambtech.dev/api/v1/auth/oidc/callback
     ```

   - Under **Advanced protocol settings**:
     - `token_endpoint_auth_method`: `client_secret_post`
   - Scopes: `openid email profile`

2. **Create Application**:
   - Name: `Jellyseerr`
   - Slug: `jellyseerr`
   - Provider: `Jellyseerr`

#### Jellyseerr Configuration

Configure via Settings > Users > OIDC:

| Setting | Value |
| --- | --- |
| OIDC Provider | Authentik |
| Client ID | (from Authentik) |
| Client Secret | (from Authentik) |
| Authorization URL | `https://auth.homelab.rambtech.dev/application/o/authorize/` |
| Token URL | `https://auth.homelab.rambtech.dev/application/o/token/` |
| User Info URL | `https://auth.homelab.rambtech.dev/application/o/userinfo/` |
| JWKS URL | `https://auth.homelab.rambtech.dev/application/o/jellyseerr/jwks/` |

---

## Part 2: Forward Auth Applications

These applications use Authentik's Proxy Provider via Traefik's forwardAuth middleware.

### Common Setup

All forward auth apps use the same Authentik middleware in Traefik:

```yaml
# Traefik dynamic config
http:
  middlewares:
    authentik:
      forwardAuth:
        address: "http://localhost:9000/outpost.goauthentik.io/auth/traefik"
        trustForwardHeader: true
        authResponseHeaders:
          - X-authentik-username
          - X-authentik-groups
          - X-authentik-email
          - X-authentik-name
          - X-authentik-uid
```

### Per-Application Proxy Providers

For granular access control, create separate Proxy Providers per application (or group of applications).

---

### Homepage (`homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev`)

**Auth Method**: Forward Auth

**Authentik:** Uses the shared Traefik Forward Auth provider.

**Traefik:**

```yaml
http:
  routers:
    homepage:
      rule: "Host(`homepage.homelab.rambtech.dev`)"
      middlewares:
        - security-headers
        - authentik
```

#### Application Configuration

None needed - Homepage has no auth.

---

### Dashy (`dashy.homelab.rambtech.dev`)

**Auth Method**: Forward Auth

Same as Homepage.

---

### Prometheus (`prometheus.homelab.rambtech.dev`)

**Auth Method**: Forward Auth

**Authentik:** Create a dedicated Proxy Provider with `admins` group binding for restricted access.

**Traefik:**

```yaml
http:
  routers:
    prometheus:
      rule: "Host(`prometheus.homelab.rambtech.dev`)"
      middlewares:
        - security-headers
        - authentik
```

---

### Alertmanager (`alertmanager.homelab.rambtech.dev`)

**Auth Method**: Forward Auth (admin-only)

Same as Prometheus - bind to `admins` group.

---

### Uptime Kuma (`status.homelab.rambtech.dev`)

**Auth Method**: Forward Auth

#### Uptime Kuma Configuration

Disable built-in authentication:

1. Go to Settings > Advanced
2. Enable "Disable Auth"

**Authentik:** Configure unauthenticated paths for public status page:

- In Proxy Provider settings, add to **Unauthenticated Paths**: `/status/*`

---

### AdGuard Home (`dns.homelab.rambtech.dev`)

**Auth Method**: Forward Auth (admin-only)

**Traefik:**

```yaml
http:
  routers:
    adguard:
      rule: "Host(`dns.homelab.rambtech.dev`)"
      middlewares:
        - security-headers
        - authentik
```

#### Note

AdGuard's built-in basic auth still functions. You can keep it as a secondary layer or disable it.

---

### qBittorrent (`qbittorrent.homelab.rambtech.dev`)

**Auth Method**: Forward Auth (admin-only)

#### qBittorrent Configuration

Configure WebUI to bypass auth for the container network:

- **Bypass authentication for clients in whitelisted IP subnets**: `10.100.0.0/16`

Or disable WebUI auth entirely if behind forward auth.

---

### Sonarr/Radarr/Lidarr/Prowlarr (`*.homelab.rambtech.dev`)

**Auth Method**: Forward Auth (admin-only)

#### *arr Stack Configuration

Edit `config.xml` for each service:

```xml
<AuthenticationMethod>External</AuthenticationMethod>
<AuthenticationRequired>DisabledForLocalAddresses</AuthenticationRequired>
```

The `X-authentik-username` header will be used for display.

---

### Bazarr (`bazarr.homelab.rambtech.dev`)

**Auth Method**: Forward Auth (admin-only)

No special configuration needed.

---

### SABnzbd (`sabnzbd.homelab.rambtech.dev`)

**Auth Method**: Forward Auth (admin-only)

Optionally disable built-in auth if behind forward auth.

---

### Traefik Dashboard (`traefik.homelab.rambtech.dev`)

**Auth Method**: Forward Auth (admin-only)

```yaml
http:
  routers:
    traefik-dashboard:
      rule: "Host(`traefik.homelab.rambtech.dev`)"
      middlewares:
        - security-headers
        - internal-only
        - authentik
      service: api@internal
```

---

### Pulse (`pulse.homelab.rambtech.dev`)

**Auth Method**: Forward Auth (admin-only)

No special configuration needed.

---

### Arcane (`arcane.homelab.rambtech.dev`)

**Auth Method**: Forward Auth (admin-only)

# Authentik - Identity Provider (SSO/OIDC)
# https://goauthentik.io/
#
# Version: 2025.10.3 (Redis removed, Postgres-only)

name: authentik

services:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # PostgreSQL Database
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  postgresql:
    image: docker.io/library/postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: authentik-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    env_file:
      - .env
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: ${PG_DB:-authentik}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${PG_USER:-authentik}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${PG_PASS:?database password required}
    volumes:
      - database:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -d $${POSTGRES_DB} -U $${POSTGRES_USER}"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 20s

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Authentik Server (Web UI + API)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  server:
    image: ${AUTHENTIK_IMAGE:-ghcr.io/goauthentik/server}:${AUTHENTIK_TAG:-2025.10.3}
    container_name: authentik-server
    command: server
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      postgresql:
        condition: service_healthy
    env_file:
      - .env
    environment:
      AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__HOST: postgresql
      AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__NAME: ${PG_DB:-authentik}
      AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__USER: ${PG_USER:-authentik}
      AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__PASSWORD: ${PG_PASS}
      AUTHENTIK_SECRET_KEY: ${AUTHENTIK_SECRET_KEY:?secret key required}
    ports:
      - "9000:9000"   # HTTP
      - "9443:9443"   # HTTPS
    volumes:
      - ./media:/media
      - ./custom-templates:/templates
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1g
          cpus: '1.5'
        reservations:
          memory: 512m
          cpus: '0.5'
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "ak", "healthcheck"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 30s

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Authentik Worker (Background Tasks)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  worker:
    image: ${AUTHENTIK_IMAGE:-ghcr.io/goauthentik/server}:${AUTHENTIK_TAG:-2025.10.3}
    container_name: authentik-worker
    command: worker
    restart: unless-stopped
    user: root
    depends_on:
      postgresql:
        condition: service_healthy
    env_file:
      - .env
    environment:
      AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__HOST: postgresql
      AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__NAME: ${PG_DB:-authentik}
      AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__USER: ${PG_USER:-authentik}
      AUTHENTIK_POSTGRESQL__PASSWORD: ${PG_PASS}
      AUTHENTIK_SECRET_KEY: ${AUTHENTIK_SECRET_KEY:?secret key required}
    volumes:
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
      - ./media:/media
      - ./certs:/certs
      - ./custom-templates:/templates
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: 1g
          cpus: '1.0'
        reservations:
          memory: 256m
          cpus: '0.25'

volumes:
  database:

# =============================================================================
# Authentik LXC - Identity Provider (SSO/OIDC)
# =============================================================================
# Container ID: 203
#
# Replaces Authelia with a more feature-rich identity provider:
#   - Native Google/GitHub OAuth federation
#   - OIDC provider for apps with native SSO support
#   - Forward auth for apps without native OAuth
#   - Centralized user/group management
#
# File Structure:
#   - main.tf:      Container, env, routes, sidecars
#   - providers.tf: OAuth sources, forward auth, OIDC providers
#   - users.tf:     User management (SOPS-encrypted)
#   - outputs.tf:   All outputs
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variables
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

variable "container_id" {
  description = "Container ID for Authentik LXC"
  type        = number
  default     = 203
}

variable "cores" {
  description = "CPU cores"
  type        = number
  default     = 2
}

variable "memory" {
  description = "Memory in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 4096  # Authentik recommended minimum
}

variable "swap" {
  description = "Swap in MB"
  type        = number
  default     = 1024
}

variable "rootfs_size" {
  description = "Root filesystem size in GB"
  type        = number
  default     = 16
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Authentik Container
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik" {
  source = "../../modules/docker-lxc"

  name         = "authentik"
  container_id = var.container_id
  proxmox_node = var.proxmox_node

  # Network (container network only - Traefik handles external access)
  container_ip = "${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}${local.network.container_netmask}"

  # Resources
  cores  = var.cores
  memory = var.memory
  swap   = var.swap

  rootfs_storage = "nvme-containers"
  rootfs_size    = var.rootfs_size

  # Unprivileged container (security hardened)
  unprivileged = true

  # Deployment
  deploy_dir  = "${path.module}/deploy"
  target_path = "/config"

  # Exclude .env template files (we generate .env from template)
  exclude_patterns = ["^\\.env"]

  # SSH
  ssh_public_key       = local.ssh_public_key
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path
  proxmox_ssh_host     = local.proxmox_ssh_host

  # Template with Docker pre-installed
  template = var.lxc_template_docker

  # Proxmox Notes
  service_name        = "Authentik"
  service_description = "Identity Provider - SSO, OIDC, and forward auth for all homelab services"

  service_urls = {
    admin    = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/"
    user     = "https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/user/"
    direct   = "http://${local.ip_registry.dashboards.authentik}:9000"
  }

  services = [
    { name = "Authentik HTTP", port = 9000, info = "Web UI and API" },
    { name = "Authentik HTTPS", port = 9443, info = "HTTPS (self-signed)" },
    { name = "PostgreSQL", port = 5432, info = "Database (internal only)" }
  ]

  custom_notes = <<-EOT
## Initial Setup

1. Access the admin interface at https://auth.${var.domain_internal}/if/admin/
2. Login with credentials from 1Password (item: authentik)
3. Configure Google OAuth source for SSO

## Forward Auth Endpoint

Add this middleware to Traefik routes for protected services:
```yaml
middlewares:
  authentik:
    forwardAuth:
      address: https://auth.${var.domain_public}/outpost.goauthentik.io/auth/traefik
      trustForwardHeader: true
      authResponseHeaders:
        - X-authentik-username
        - X-authentik-groups
        - X-authentik-email
        - X-authentik-name
        - X-authentik-uid
        - X-authentik-jwt
        - X-authentik-meta-jwks
        - X-authentik-meta-outpost
        - X-authentik-meta-provider
        - X-authentik-meta-app
        - X-authentik-meta-version
```

## Quick Commands

```bash
# View server logs
docker logs -f authentik-server

# View worker logs
docker logs -f authentik-worker

# Database backup
docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > backup.sql

# Restart services
cd /config && docker compose restart
```

## OIDC Configuration

For apps with native OIDC support, create a Provider in Authentik:
1. Admin → Providers → Create OAuth2/OIDC Provider
2. Set redirect URI for the app
3. Create Application linking to the provider
4. Use client_id and client_secret in the app config

## Managed by OpenTofu

Run `task tofu:apply APP=authentik` to update.
EOT

  tags = ["authentik", "auth", "sso", "oidc", "identity"]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create .env file with secrets
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generate .env file locally with secrets from 1Password, then sync to container

resource "local_sensitive_file" "authentik_env" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/.env.tpl", {
    postgres_password = local.op.authentik_postgres_password
    secret_key        = local.op.authentik_secret_key
    admin_email       = "admin@${var.domain_internal}"
    admin_password    = local.op.authentik_admin_password
  })
  filename        = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik.env"
  file_permission = "0600"
}

resource "filesync_file" "authentik_env" {
  source      = local_sensitive_file.authentik_env.filename
  destination = "/config/.env"
  host        = module.authentik.ip_address

  mode = "0600"

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Route - Self-Service Route Registration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_route" {
  source = "../../modules/traefik-route"

  app_name    = "authentik"
  backend_url = "http://${module.authentik.ip_address}:9000"

  # Internal route (HTTPS via Let's Encrypt)
  # Using "auth" subdomain to match Authelia for easier migration
  internal_domain = "auth.${var.domain_internal}"

  # Public route for external access (Google OAuth redirect)
  public_domain = "auth.${var.domain_public}"

  # Traefik config
  traefik_host         = local.traefik_ip
  ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  # No auth middleware on the auth service itself!
  internal_middlewares = ["security-headers"]
  # cloudflare-https sets X-Forwarded-Proto: https to fix mixed content issues
  public_middlewares   = ["cloudflare-https", "security-headers"]
  # Use "web" entrypoint for public - Cloudflare handles TLS and forwards HTTP to origin
  public_entrypoint    = ["web"]

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Traefik Forward Auth Middleware
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generates the forwardAuth middleware config and syncs to Traefik

resource "local_file" "traefik_middleware" {
  content = templatefile("${path.module}/deploy/traefik-middleware.yml.tpl", {
    authentik_ip = module.authentik.ip_address
  })
  filename = "${path.module}/.terraform/authentik-middleware.yml"
}

resource "filesync_file" "traefik_middleware" {
  source      = local_file.traefik_middleware.filename
  destination = "/config/dynamic/authentik-middleware.yml"
  host        = local.traefik_ip

  mode = "0644"

  depends_on = [module.authentik, local_file.traefik_middleware]
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Backup Configuration - PBS Client + Sidecars
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

module "authentik_sidecars" {
  source = "../../modules/lxc-sidecars"

  container_id   = module.authentik.container_id
  container_ip   = module.authentik.ip_address
  container_name = "authentik"

  proxmox_ssh_host             = local.proxmox_ssh_host
  proxmox_ssh_private_key_path = var.ssh_private_key_path

  backup = {
    enabled   = true
    schedule  = "Sun 03:00"  # Weekly backup
    retention = "4"          # Keep 4 weekly backups
    namespace = "lxc-203"

    # Dump PostgreSQL before backup
    pre_backup_commands = [
      {
        name    = "Backup PostgreSQL database"
        command = "docker exec authentik-postgres pg_dump -U authentik authentik > /config/authentik-db-backup.sql"
        timeout = 120
      }
    ]

    include_paths = ["/config"]
    exclude_paths = ["/var/lib/docker/overlay2"]

    ntfy_priority = "default"
    ntfy_tags     = "backup,authentik"
  }

  # Container monitoring agents
  pulse_agent = {
    enabled     = true
    pulse_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].pulse_token
  }

  arcane_agent = {
    enabled         = true
    bootstrap_token = local.agent_tokens["authentik"].arcane_bootstrap_token
  }

  alloy_agent = {
    enabled  = true
    username = local.op.alloy_telemetry_username
    password = local.op.alloy_telemetry_password
  }

  depends_on = [module.authentik]
}

# =============================================================================
# Authentik Providers - OAuth Sources, Forward Auth, OIDC Providers
# =============================================================================
# This file contains all Authentik provider configurations:
#   - Google OAuth source (SSO via Google)
#   - Forward auth provider for Traefik
#   - OIDC providers for apps with native SSO support (future)
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Terraform API Token - Non-expiring
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Creates a non-expiring API token for Terraform to manage authentik.
# The token value is stored in 1Password and used by the provider.
#
# Bootstrap: Create a short-lived token in UI first, run tofu apply,
# then update 1Password with the new token value from the output.

data "authentik_user" "akadmin" {
  username = "akadmin"
}

resource "authentik_token" "terraform" {
  identifier   = "terraform-api"
  user         = data.authentik_user.akadmin.id
  intent       = "api"
  expiring     = false  # Never expires
  description  = "API token for OpenTofu/Terraform - managed by IaC"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Google OAuth Source - SSO via Google Account
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Allows users to login with their Google account
# Credentials stored in 1Password (authentik item)

data "authentik_flow" "default_source_authentication" {
  slug = "default-source-authentication"
}

resource "authentik_source_oauth" "google" {
  name                = "Google"
  slug                = "google"
  authentication_flow = data.authentik_flow.default_source_authentication.id

  # No enrollment flow - users must be pre-created in authentik
  # This prevents unauthorized users from self-registering
  enrollment_flow = ""

  provider_type   = "google"
  consumer_key    = local.op.authentik_google_client_id
  consumer_secret = local.op.authentik_google_client_secret

  # Match users by email and link OAuth source on first login
  # "email_link" matches by email and creates the link automatically
  user_matching_mode = "email_link"

  # Policy engine mode
  policy_engine_mode = "any"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Link Google OAuth to Login Flow
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# NOTE: The Google source must be manually added to the identification stage
# in the authentik admin UI:
#   1. Go to Flows & Stages → Stages
#   2. Edit "default-authentication-identification"
#   3. Add "Google" to the Sources field
#   4. Save
#
# This is required because the stage already exists and can't be recreated
# via Terraform without importing it first.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Forward Auth Provider - For protecting services via Traefik
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Creates a Proxy Provider in forward auth mode for protecting services
# that don't have native OIDC support. The embedded outpost handles the auth.

data "authentik_flow" "default_authorization" {
  slug = "default-provider-authorization-implicit-consent"
}

data "authentik_flow" "default_invalidation" {
  slug = "default-provider-invalidation-flow"
}

resource "authentik_provider_proxy" "forward_auth" {
  name               = "Traefik Forward Auth"
  mode               = "forward_domain"  # Domain mode - protects all subdomains
  authorization_flow = data.authentik_flow.default_authorization.id
  invalidation_flow  = data.authentik_flow.default_invalidation.id

  # External host - the authentik outpost's external URL for browser redirects
  external_host = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}"

  # Cookie settings for SSO across all subdomains
  # Must be the root domain to work with both *.homelab.rambtech.dev and auth.rambtech.dev
  cookie_domain = var.domain_public
}

resource "authentik_application" "forward_auth" {
  name              = "Homelab Forward Auth"
  slug              = "homelab-forward-auth"
  protocol_provider = authentik_provider_proxy.forward_auth.id

  meta_description = "Forward authentication for homelab services protected by Traefik"
  meta_publisher   = "Homelab Infrastructure"

  # Open to all authenticated users
  policy_engine_mode = "any"
}

# Update the embedded outpost to include the forward auth provider
# Note: The embedded outpost is managed by authentik, we just update its providers
resource "authentik_outpost" "embedded" {
  name               = "authentik Embedded Outpost"
  type               = "proxy"
  protocol_providers = [authentik_provider_proxy.forward_auth.id]

  config = jsonencode({
    # Internal URL for outpost-to-authentik communication
    authentik_host          = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}"
    # Browser URL - what users see (HTTPS via Cloudflare)
    authentik_host_browser  = "https://auth.${var.domain_public}"
    authentik_host_insecure = false
    log_level               = "info"
  })

  lifecycle {
    # The embedded outpost already exists, we're just updating it
    ignore_changes = [service_connection]
  }
}

# =============================================================================
# Authentik Branding - Custom login page appearance
# =============================================================================
# Customizes the login page with:
#   - Custom title and logo
#   - Simplified login flow (Google OAuth focused)
#   - 7-day session duration
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Custom Brand Configuration
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Create brand for our auth domain
# This brand will be used when accessing via auth.rambtech.dev
resource "authentik_brand" "homelab" {
  domain           = "auth.${var.domain_public}"  # Must match full hostname
  default          = false  # Don't conflict with authentik-default
  branding_title   = "Homelab"
  branding_favicon = "/static/dist/assets/icons/icon.png"
  branding_logo    = "/static/dist/assets/icons/icon_left_brand.svg"

  # Use custom authentication flow (Google OAuth focused)
  flow_authentication = authentik_flow.authentication.uuid
  flow_invalidation   = data.authentik_flow.default_invalidation.id
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Custom Authentication Flow - Google OAuth focused
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Creates a simplified authentication flow that shows Google login prominently

resource "authentik_flow" "authentication" {
  name               = "Homelab Authentication"
  title              = "Welcome to Homelab"
  slug               = "homelab-authentication"
  designation        = "authentication"
  policy_engine_mode = "any"

  # Use sidebar layout for cleaner appearance
  layout = "sidebar_right"

  # Custom background (optional - uses default if not set)
  # background = "/static/dist/assets/images/flow_background.jpg"
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Flow Stages
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Stage 1: Identification - Show ONLY Google OAuth (no email/password)
resource "authentik_stage_identification" "login" {
  name = "homelab-identification"

  # Empty user_fields = no username/email input shown
  user_fields = []

  # Show Google OAuth source on the identification page
  sources = [authentik_source_oauth.google.uuid]

  # No password stage - Google OAuth only
  # password_stage = authentik_stage_password.password.id

  show_source_labels = true
}

# Stage 2: Password (for fallback local login)
resource "authentik_stage_password" "password" {
  name     = "homelab-password"
  backends = ["authentik.core.auth.InbuiltBackend"]
}

# Stage 3: User Login (creates session)
resource "authentik_stage_user_login" "login" {
  name                     = "homelab-user-login"
  session_duration         = "days=7"  # Stay logged in for 7 days
  remember_me_offset       = "days=30" # Remember me for 30 days
  terminate_other_sessions = false
}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Flow Stage Bindings - Connect stages to flow
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

resource "authentik_flow_stage_binding" "identification" {
  target = authentik_flow.authentication.uuid
  stage  = authentik_stage_identification.login.id
  order  = 10
}

resource "authentik_flow_stage_binding" "password" {
  target = authentik_flow.authentication.uuid
  stage  = authentik_stage_password.password.id
  order  = 20
}

resource "authentik_flow_stage_binding" "user_login" {
  target = authentik_flow.authentication.uuid
  stage  = authentik_stage_user_login.login.id
  order  = 30
}
